GRANT AWARD RESOLUTION SUMMARY REPORT
2014Saving Places Conference Grant
RESOLUTION:
First Reading, January13,2014; Finance Committee January 21,2014;
Second Reading, January 27,2014
PREPAREDBY: Jim Flesher, Senior Planner
RECOMMENDATION: The Urban Planning Office recommends acceptance of the Grant and
adoption of the attached resolution.
The Wyoming State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO) has approved the Cheyenne Historic
Preservation Board's application for a grant to fund attendance of three members at the 2014
Saving Places Conference February 5th,6th, and 7th in Denver, Colorado.
The $1,542 grant pays for conference registration, hotel, and parking. The Board members
attending will pay for their own transportation andmeals not provided at the conference, which,
along with their time, while be considered the grant match.
According to the colorado preservation.org website:“The 2014 conference aims to empower
participants to strengthen partnerships within their local communities, expanding positive
perceptions of preservation and encouraging discussions centered on common community visions
for the future of preservation."
